title.narrative: 1.1: Level of aggregate revenue outturn as percentage of budgeted revenue

description.narrative: The score is based on the ratio of actual to budgeted revenue in the last three years, following the criterion of Performance Indicator 3.1 of the Public Expenditure and Financial Accountability (PEFA) Methodology 2016.

comment.narrative: Equivalent to PEFA B score. Score B is obtained when actual revenue falls between 94 and 112 of budgeted revenue in at least two of the last three years. The relevant values for 2018 2019 and 2020 were 108.5 110.1 and 98 respectively.

Equivalent to PEFA A score. Score A is obtained when actual revenue falls between 97 and 106 of budgeted revenue in at least two of the last three years. For the 2025 target the completed fiscal years under consideration will be 2022 2023 and 2024.

title.narrative: Country score according to the International Budget Partnerships Open Budget Index

description.narrative: The Open Budget Index (OBI) assigns each country a score from 0 to 100 based on the simple average of the numerical value of each of the responses to the 109 questions in the questionnaire that assess the public availability of budget information.The Open Budget Survey is a comprehensive analysis and survey that evaluates whether governments give the public access to budget information and opportunities to participate in the budget process at the national level. The Survey also assesses the capacity and independence of formal oversight institutions.

comment.narrative: value date release date of 2023 Open Budget Survey
